while_step.measures: one step of a `while i < n` loop that adds `i` to an `int64` total

range_step.measures: one step of a `for i in range(n)` loop that adds `i` to an `int64` total

float_read.measures: reading one element of a `list[float64]` and adding it to a total

int32_read.measures: reading one element of a `list[int32]` and adding it to an `int32` total

u8_cast.measures: reading one element of a `list[uint8]`, casting it to `uint32` and adding it

sort_ints.measures: sorting a `list[int64]` of `count` pseudo-random values, per element

str_slice.measures: `text[5000:5010]` on a 10,000-byte `str`, and the slice's length

dict_remove.measures: removing one key from a `dict[int64, int64]` of `count` keys, oldest key first

dict_get_str.measures: one `get` on a `dict[str, int64]` of 1,000 keys, matching the result

list_push.measures: appending one `float64` and one two-field class instance to lists

class_field_read.measures: reading one `float64` field of a class instance held in a list

field_write.measures: `items[i].count += 1` on a class instance held in a list

enum_match.measures: passing one enum value from a list to a function that matches on it

call.measures: calling a two-argument `int64` function that LLVM inlines, against the same arithmetic written in the loop

iterator_next.measures: one step of a `for` loop over a user `Iterator[int64]` class, adding the item to a total

generator_next.measures: one `yield` and resume of a generator in a `for` loop, adding the item to a total

generator_start.measures: creating a one-item generator, running it to its end, and dropping it

generator_value.measures: one item of a generator passed to a function that sums it with a `for` loop

generator_pipeline.measures: one item of a generator that doubles the items of another generator it was passed

generator_list.measures: one item of a generator that yields the items of a `list[int64]` it owns

generator_class.measures: one item of a generator whose loop counter is a field of a class instance local
